reason: Example. The retained boundary term of the first variation of int f(x,u,u') on a free interval gives f_xi(a)=f_xi(b)=0 in addition to the Euler-Lagrange equation; for the quadratic model this is u''=-g with u'(a)=u'(b)=0. Sources [CV] Section 3.5 and [MA] Chapter 1 Section 2.3, [SO] Section 1.4. Dependencies are the natural-boundary-condition theorem and the classical Euler-Lagrange corollary. Re-recorded because the growth hypotheses and the Fatou step of [[lem-differentiation-of-an-integral-functional]] and [[thm-direct-method-for-convex-integral-functionals]] were corrected during final review (see the batch notes); this item's mathematical content is unchanged.
